question: Kolayat festival is celebrated in which Indian state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajasthan**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The annual fair of Kolayat is organized in Bikaner, Rajasthan**__.

 __
 
• It is also called the **Kapil Muni Mela.**
 
• The fair is organized at the bank of the** Kolayat river.**
 
• The fair is organized in the** month of Karthik of the Hindu Calendar.**
